intro.heading: How SiteFlow Connects Everything
intro.body: SiteFlow integrates all construction workflows from sales enquiry to final accounts. Every module shares data in real time. BOQs flow into budgets. Procurement updates inventory. Site progress triggers billing. All transactions connect to project P&L automatically without manual consolidation.

faqs.q: What is SiteFlow Construction ERP software?
faqs.a: SiteFlow construction ERP software is an integrated platform managing all aspects of construction operations from pre-sales through final accounts. Unlike generic ERP systems designed for manufacturing or retail, construction ERP handles industry-specific workflows like BOQ management, site progress tracking, material procurement, labour deployment, subcontractor billing, equipment allocation, and project-wise profitability.

faqs.q: How is SiteFlow different from stand-alone accounting software?
faqs.a: Stand-alone accounting software is designed for financial bookkeeping, tax compliance, and company-level accounts. It cannot track site execution, link BOQs to actual costs, manage complex retention and advance logic, or provide project-wise profitability visibility. SiteFlow ERP integrates execution with financial workflows, keeping data accurate and linked to real-world progress.

faqs.q: Does SiteFlow ERP work on mobile for site teams?
faqs.a: Yes. Mobile-first design is essential for construction ERP because execution happens on site, not in offices. Site engineers, supervisors, and field teams use mobile apps for daily progress recording, geo-tagged photo uploads, material requisitions, labour attendance, quality inspections, and milestone documentation. Offline mode allows work in areas without connectivity.
